title: JavaScript: log
description: A console log message forwarded to Insights when insights.console is enabled.

severity.description: Console method that produced the message, e.g. "log", "info", "warn", "error", "debug".

message.description: First argument when it is a string. Omitted when the first argument is not a string.

args.description: Remaining console arguments when the first argument is a string, or all arguments otherwise.
